anchor.quote: With it come pattern templates — mythological frameworks, reality interpretation protocols

claims.rationale: The excerpt moves from maternal mitochondrial inheritance to inherited myth and reality-interpretation templates without tracing ingredients, transformation, or Noesis authorship, presenting the synthesis as biology.

legacy.quote: "With it come pattern templates — mythological frameworks, reality interpretation protocols"
legacy.note: Frontmatter states mtDNA→myth-template inheritance as fact; body carries the claim, so removal here does not collapse the post.

anchor.quote: passes exclusively through the maternal line. It does not recombine

claims.rationale: Human mtDNA is ordinarily maternally inherited with negligible recombination, but the absolute “exclusively” and “does not recombine” wording exceeds the qualified evidence and cites no source.

legacy.quote: "passes exclusively through the maternal line. It does not recombine"
legacy.note: Directly sequenced, non-model data; the accurate factual base the post correctly labels "This is biology" (L30).

anchor.quote: It encodes the cellular processing architecture through which myths are received

claims.rationale: No evidence in the post establishes that mitochondrial DNA encodes a cellular architecture for receiving myths; the asserted mechanism needs a population, measure, and source.

legacy.quote: "It encodes the cellular processing architecture through which myths are received"
legacy.note: Speculative mechanism stated as fact ("Here is the mechanism," L46). No established science holds mtDNA encodes myth-reception architecture; the L30 "pattern recognition" tag is overridden by mechanism framing.

claims.rationale: Mitochondria regulate cellular energy production through well-characterized oxidative metabolism; this narrow physiological statement is traceable and does not establish later cognitive claims.

anchor.quote: Here is the mechanism: mitochondria regulate cellular energy production. The efficiency and pattern of that production varies by lineage. Different mitochondrial haplogroups — clusters of related maternal lineages — produce energy with different characteristics, optimized over thousands of years of adaptation to different environments, diets, climates, and survival pressures.

claims.rationale: Lineage-linked energetic variation and adaptation are expanded into optimized haplogroup-specific energy characteristics without named studies, measured effect sizes, populations, or uncertainty.

legacy.quote: "haplogroups … produce energy with different characteristics, optimized over thousands of years"
legacy.note: Adaptationist haplogroup-energetics hypothesis (Wallace line of research) presented as settled optimization history.

anchor.quote: These energy patterns influence neural processing. A brain powered by mitochondria adapted to high-altitude, low-oxygen environments processes information differently than a brain powered by mitochondria adapted to tropical environments with high caloric density. Not better or worse. Differently. The pattern of energy availability shapes the pattern of pattern recognition.

claims.rationale: The passage combines mitochondrial adaptation, neural processing, environment, and pattern recognition into a causal Noesis inference without tracing each ingredient or declaring the synthesis.

legacy.quote: "These energy patterns influence neural processing … processes information differently"
legacy.note: Causal arrow runs energetic substrate → cognition; matter before mind, contra the Hermetic core equation.

anchor.quote: cognitive architectures built on energetic substrates — mitochondrial patterns expressing as story patterns

claims.rationale: “Mitochondrial patterns expressing as story patterns” literalizes an untraced cross-domain synthesis and presents it as inherited mechanism rather than declared Noesis interpretation.

legacy.quote: "cognitive architectures built on energetic substrates — mitochondrial patterns expressing as story patterns"
legacy.note: Thesis sentence: mythology as expression of cellular energetics. "These are not cultural accidents" and "Not metaphorically" (L28) are §5 silent-upgrade markers.

anchor.quote: a biological inheritance of pattern recognition protocols transmitted through the maternal mitochondrial line

claims.rationale: The claimed biological transmission of pattern-recognition protocols combines mtDNA inheritance with a subconscious model while hiding the inferential transformation and authorship.

legacy.quote: "a biological inheritance of pattern recognition protocols transmitted through the maternal mitochondrial line"
legacy.note: Explicitly rejects the psychological account in favor of a matter-first one; the subconscious is re-founded on chemistry.

anchor.quote: what Joseph Campbell identified as the monomyth

claims.rationale: Joseph Campbell is accurately named as the source associated with the monomyth; this attribution passes without treating the monomyth as an empirical law.

legacy.quote: "what Joseph Campbell identified as the monomyth"

anchor.quote: Inanna going underground in the Sumerian Descent of Inanna

claims.rationale: Inanna’s descent is accurately located in the named Sumerian Descent of Inanna tradition; the row reports the textual narrative rather than proving the article’s biological synthesis.

legacy.quote: "Inanna going underground in the Sumerian *Descent of Inanna*"
legacy.note: Accurate textual references (also Persephone / Homeric *Hymn to Demeter*); judged as literary history, correct.

anchor.quote: The mitochondrial subconscious operates as a Kha-Ba-La triad

claims.rationale: The Kha–Ba–La triad is explicit house vocabulary, is transformed into three defined absence diagnostics, recurs through the diagnostic section, and is internally reproducible and structurally consequential.

legacy.quote: "The mitochondrial subconscious operates as a Kha-Ba-La triad"
legacy.note: House triad operationalized through three absence diagnostics (L70–76); canonical structure, removal guts the post's diagnostic half.

anchor.quote: also drives the policy decisions of a nation-state

legacy.quote: "also drives the policy decisions of a nation-state"

anchor.quote: atoms forged in stellar cores, passed through eons

claims.rationale: Stellar nucleosynthesis and the later incorporation of forged atoms into living cells are independently established physical processes; the narrow claim does not validate the surrounding analogy.

legacy.quote: "atoms forged in stellar cores, passed through eons"

anchor.quote: the same pattern operates across all registers

claims.rationale: The cellular-to-galactic recurrence combines mitochondrial and stellar cycles, expressly denies metaphor, and asserts one universal pattern without tracing a structure-preserving transformation or Noesis authorship.

legacy.quote: "the same pattern operates across all registers"
legacy.note: Hermetic correspondence ("mirrors" → "not metaphor"); scale-recursion is house cosmology by definition (§9).

anchor.quote: optimized survival in a Pleistocene ice age now drive metabolic disease

claims.rationale: The Pleistocene-optimization-to-modern-disease claim compresses evolutionary-mismatch hypotheses into a settled causal mechanism without populations, measures, effect sizes, or sources.

legacy.quote: "optimized survival in a Pleistocene ice age now drive metabolic disease"
legacy.note: Evolutionary-mismatch / thrifty-genotype-flavored hypothesis stated as settled; biomarkers named (cortisol, insulin) are real, the optimization story is a model.

legacy.quote: "a social media algorithm — triggers a famine-response pattern"

legacy.quote: "It is encoded in your cellular architecture"
